fact: Webmanagercenter, citing Nouakchott Innovation Lab, says the 2025 Fintech Mauritanie Hackathon logged 150 projects and four then joined the Lab's accompaniment pipeline.

The Africa Capital Report says the Central Bank of Mauritania's DigiLab and BCM Fintech Program give selected teams three-month accompaniment including incubation, and Nouakchott Innovation Lab runs a local Founder Institute chapter.
